ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Prophet Muhammad being a messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine affirmation of Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) status as the Seal of the Prophets, linking his mission to the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the legitimacy of his message by connecting him to the lineage of earlier messengers, reinforcing the concept of *Nubuwwah* (prophethood) as a core pillar of faith.
